entry.focal: The lit genkan porch 36 m away, framed by the dark torii, with a near pair of white post lanterns. The torii itself is unlit, and the falls (hero) are off-frame; only an orange-brown sliver shows at the far left edge.
entry.next_visible: Yes: the porch and its two lanterns read clearly through the torii.

reveal.focal: Nothing. The frame is filled by an unlit dark-brown slab (the falls sheet, 5 m away) against black rock. Both the 16:9 and the 9:16 frames are effectively black.

concept.focal: The porch glow at the end of a slot between two tall rock walls, plus lantern posts. Plan 31 shows a road on a ledge, open to the south, lined with continuous lantern railings; this reads as a canyon.

strip.focal: The porch glow throughout, with lanterns converging on it. The falls never appear, there is no visible stream or bridge, and the south side never opens.
strip.next_visible: Yes: the torii and porch ahead in every frame, which is the space's one success.

fixes.detail: At (3.2,60.9) the falls are 58 deg left of the entry axis, outside the frame. Shift the whole falls group east about 5 m (hero, lights[1] falls_uplight, w_road_plunge, w_road_stream, road_bridge) so the falls sit about 7 m ahead-left (about 28 deg) of the entry camera while the torii stays dead ahead. Also give the falls sheet an emissive white-teal material: it renders as an unlit brown slab.

Its snap_status is 'marker' and it emits nothing visible. It needs a real light (teal-white, brighter than any lantern) or an emissive spray volume, so that the hero is the brightest thing per the brief.

Only 2 posts were produced for a 13 m road: the avoid poly x 1.8-7.2 removes half the run and the portals remove the rest. Shrink the avoid poly to the bridge deck only (about x 3-6) and emit both rows, spacing [3.2,4.2], from x 0.5 to 12, so the 'two converging rows' of plan 31 exist.
It resolved at z -0.4, sunk into the plunge-pool band (pool spans y 59.3-61.9). Move it to (1.2,58.1) and snap to the road at z 0.

The 7.8 m runs dressing[1] and dressing[3] each produced one 1.5 m segment, and dressing[0] and dressing[2] produced nothing. Railings must be continuous along their 'along' polylines, and none is visible in any frame. The rock_cluster scatter also produced zero objects.

top_change: Make the falls exist at eye level: move the falls group about 5 m east into the entry frame and make the falls the brightest, uplit, white-teal thing on the road.
plausibility: Tall rock walls close both sides of the road. The brief and plan 31 have a north flank and a south side that drops to the cascade pools and the sea, so the south rock wall should go (shell/terrain, lead).
The stream is supposed to cross under the bridge, but no gap, parapet or water is visible from the road.
The hero_visible check reports 0.94 at entry although the hero is effectively off-frame and unlit, so the check is not measuring what the eye sees.
